title: Fix rejected drain PR #183 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-133)
description:
Drain PR #183 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-133`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-133 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-133`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-133` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- [major] scope creep: tests/speak.test.mjs line 130-140 — the test modifies the real budget.json file instead of using a temporary test fixture, which could corrupt the project state and affect other tests — refactor to use a temporary test directory and mock file system for all file operations
- [major] fragile test: tests/speak.test.mjs line 130-140 — the test relies on the actual project's budget.json and could break if the file structure changes — create isolated test fixtures instead of modifying real project files
- [major] silent error handling: agents/speak.mjs line 47 and 60 — empty catch blocks swallow parse errors without logging, making debugging difficult — add at least debug-level logging for parse failures
- [minor] missing newline: agents/speak.mjs and tests/speak.test.mjs — both files missing newline at end of file, violating common code style — add final newline to both files
